abstract:
RLinf: Reinforcement Learning Infrastructure for Embodied and Agentic AI

[ ](README.md) [ ](README.zh-CN.md) RLinf: Reinforcement Learning Infrastructure for Embodied and Agentic AI RLinf is a flexible and scalable open-source RL infrastructure designed for Embodied and Agentic AI. The 'inf' in RLinf stands for `Infrastructure`, highlighting its role as a robust backbone for next-generation training. It also stands for `Infinite`, symbolizing the system’s support for open-ended learning, continuous generalization, and limitless possibilities in intelligence development. ## What's NEW! - [2026/09] 🔥 RLinf refactors real-world robots and environments, using a unified robotics interface to manage hardware, tasks, and rollout wrappers separately. Docs: [Robotics Interface](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/concepts/robotics.html), [Robotics Architecture](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/concepts/robotics_architecture.html), [Real-World Tasks and Environments](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/concepts/realworld_envs.html), [Add a Robot](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/extending/new_robot.html), [Add a Real-World Task](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/extending/new_task.html), [Teleoperation](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/guides/teleoperation.html). - [2026/09] 🔥 RLinf supports RL on π₀-FAST. Doc: [π₀-FAST](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/examples/embodied/pi0_fast.html). - [2026/09] 🔥 RLinf supports Biren GPUs. PR: [Biren GPU support (#1581)](https://github.com/RLinf/RLinf/pull/1581). - [2026/09] 🔥 RLinf supports ApxInf-accelerated evaluation of π₀.₅ on LIBERO. RLinf keeps the native OpenPI transform chain and enters the engine through its L1 inference interface. Doc: [ApxInf LIBERO eval](https://rlinf.readthedocs.io/en/latest/rst_source/evaluations/guides/libero.html#apxinf-backend). - [2026/09] 🔥 RLinf supports FSDP supervised fine-tuning and batched LIBERO evaluation for [FastWAM](https://github.com/yuantianyuan01/Fast
abstract_zh: RLinf是一个灵活且可扩展的开源强化学习基础设施，专为具身与智能体AI设计。名称中的“inf”代表“Infrastructure”（基础设施），强调其作为下一代训练稳健后端的角色；同时也代表“Infinite”（无限），象征系统对开放式学习、持续泛化以及智能发展无限可能性的支持。最新进展包括：支持GR00T-N1.7、Polaris模拟器、Genesis等平台的强化学习微调；通过系统级优化（精简、按需观测、混合流水线并行），在BEHAVIOR模拟器上实现了端到端加速，将rollout延迟从1028.7毫秒/步降至41.2毫秒/步。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：RLinf 是一个面向具身与 Agentic AI 的开源 RL 基础设施，通过统一的 Robotics Interface 把硬件、任务与 rollout wrapper 解耦管理，并在同一套训练框架内集成仿真与真机、VLA 模型 RL 微调、SFT 与分布式评估等能力。


# 一、动机

> 具身智能与 VLA 大模型的强化学习训练缺乏统一、可扩展的基础设施：仿真环境、真实机器人硬件、任务定义与 rollout 封装往往彼此耦合，难以复用与横向扩展，也缺少对主流 VLA 模型（如 π₀ 系列）做 RL 后训练的标准化支持。


# 二、方法

> RLinf 是一个面向具身与 Agentic AI 的开源 RL 基础设施，通过统一的 Robotics Interface 把硬件、任务与 rollout wrapper 解耦管理，并在同一套训练框架内集成仿真与真机、VLA 模型 RL 微调、SFT 与分布式评估等能力。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 摘要层面给出的是能力清单而非量化指标：2026/09 起重构真机与环境接口，实现硬件/任务/rollout 分离；新增对 π₀-FAST 的 RL 支持；新增对 π₀.₅ 在 LIBERO 上经 ApxInf 加速的评估（保留原生 OpenPI transform chain，走 L1 推理接口）；新增对 FastWAM 的 FSDP 监督微调与批量 LIBERO 评估；并扩展至壁仞（Biren）GPU 支持。


# 四、对我的启发

> 该工作是工程与生态层面的基础设施贡献，摘要未提供与基线对比的成功率/吞吐等定量结果，需读文档与代码确认其真实收益；其「硬件—任务—rollout 解耦」的设计思路对构建可跨本体复用的具身 RL 训练管线有直接参考价值，尤其是真机与仿真统一接口、以及 VLA 模型 RL 后训练的工程范式。
